IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Representatives Sullivan, Priest, Haler, Santos, and Ormsby

Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the design of the state assessment system and the WASL.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the design of the state assessment system andthe Washington assessment of student learning; and creating a newsection.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that, according to arecent report from a consultant retained by the state board ofeducation, endofcourse assessments have certain advantages overcomprehensive assessments such as the current form of the Washingtonassessment of student learning, and in most other areas endofcourseassessments are comparable to comprehensive assessments in meetingpublic policy objectives for a statewide assessment system. Thelegislature further finds that because the state's assessment contractwill be renegotiated before the end of 2008, the 2008 legislature hasan opportunity to provide policy direction in the design of the stateassessment system and the design of the Washington assessment ofstudent learning.
